description: The Thermal Power Library is a commercial Modelica library from Modelon for modelling, simulation and optimisation of thermal power plant operation, including district heating networks, and is one of the commercial libraries listed in the Modelica Association's library index. Contents: component models and predefined templates for concentrated solar, gas, coal and nuclear plants, with numerically robust fluid models, dynamic and steady-state simulation in one model, start-up sequences, plant-wide control design and emergency scenario simulation. Coupled with Modelon's OPTIMICA Compiler Toolkit it solves dynamic optimisation problems through a Python interface, for example plant start-up or district heating production planning. Applications named by Modelon include control strategies for rapid load changes with more renewables, carbon capture plants, optimisation-based scheduling of district heating production units, small modular reactors and solar thermal storage configurations. Producer: Modelon. Coverage: generic plants and networks. Format and access: Modelica library available in Modelon Impact and for integration into third-party platforms; demonstrations on request. Licence: commercial Modelon licence. Caveats: needs a paid licence and a Modelica tool; the Modelica source is viewable by licensed users. Simulation uses: transient behaviour of power plants and district heating supply under changing demand, control and emergency scenarios, and production scheduling. Related records: model-modelica-buildings-library, model-disheatlib-modelica-district-heating and model-transient-library.
